posts.title: (Mis)adventures in pottery: exploring texture and mark making
posts.description: With some basic hand building skills under my belt, I turned my attention to creating textures and mark making on clay surfaces. Join me for some more wonky, handmade creations, as I’m once again reminded to enjoy the process.

posts.title: (Mis)adventures in pottery: learning to enjoy the creative process
posts.description: Picking up a new skill usually means being terrible at it first. I often feel Iike I need to be good at artistic pursuits, even new ones. But this pottery course reminded me that it’s okay to fail and it’s really the journey that matters.

posts.title: Review: ten sketchbooks for watercolour and mixed media
posts.description: Looking for that perfect sketchbook? In this post, I review sketchbooks from Moleskine, SM-LT, Stillman & Birn, Traveler’s Notebook, and more! We’ll take a look at how each paper performs with mixed media and also how each sketchbook is bound.
